summary: First test run for JobPilot. Ran 31 pytest backend tests (30 pass, 1 AI test skipped by design) covering health, auth (login/logout/register/onboarding/me), CV vault (versions/restore), jobs list/filter/refresh/manual/searches, applications full CRUD + notes + contacts + interview_at reminder scheduling, reminders lifecycle, dashboard, notifications, billing 503 checkout, gmail not-connected, admin gating (demo forbidden, admin allowed for stats/users/plans/sources/audit), privacy export. Frontend smoke-tested login/logout/wrong-password, unauth redirect, navigation across CV/Jobs/Tracker/Reminders/Dashboard/Billing/Settings/Admin, admin login, legal pages (bilingual), and confirmed billing 'payments not activated' notice.

ui_bugs.issue: On quick load, body innerText was empty (page rendered blank content) — likely a delayed render or missing loading skeleton for empty kanban state. Worth verifying with a longer wait.

integration_issues.issue: Selectors `.error, [class*=error], [role=alert], [class*=destructive]` returned empty text after failed login — visible error may not be attached to a discoverable element; consider adding data-testid="login-error" to the error banner.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid="login-error" (or similar) to the wrong-password error message for reliable test detection.
Optional: give the Tracker page a visible skeleton/empty state so it renders content immediately (its body was empty on initial hit).
Optional: replace default document.title 'Emergent | Fullstack App' with app-appropriate titles per route for SEO/tests.
Note: /app/dashboard is not a route — Dashboard is the index at /app. Any UI copy or link pointing to /app/dashboard would 404-redirect to landing. Verify all internal links go to /app.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS_ORIGINS is required (no default) — good fail-fast.
r_auth.login correctly locks after 5 failed attempts (15 min) and uses bcrypt via hash_password.
r_cv.py: PDF/DOCX text extraction has an 80-char minimum and 8MB size cap — good.
r_apps.schedule_rules: deletes only auto+pending/snoozed reminders before rescheduling — correct.
r_apps.approve auto-creates 'preparing' application if missing — matches spec.
Billing checkout requires origin_url — main agent should ensure frontend always sends it; otherwise users get an unhelpful 422 instead of the expected 503 'payments_not_configured' notice.
Frontend App.js has no /app/dashboard route; catch-all `*` -> Navigate to `/` may hide real dead links.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all navigations & auth work; minor issues noted)

Throwaway users register with test_<uuid>@example.com; not deleted (would require admin-delete or GDPR flow). Main agent may prune users where email starts with test_ and domain example.com if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and runs in ~5s. Slow AI tests (tailor/review) are gated by env RUN_AI_TESTS=1 — run manually if needed (they hit Claude, ~90s). Billing checkout requires JSON body {plan_id, origin_url}. /api/admin/audit, /api/privacy/export, /api/integrations/gmail/status are all working. Frontend: dashboard is the INDEX at /app (no /app/dashboard route). Language toggle has data-testid='language-toggle' inside AppShell only (Landing has its own). Wrong-password error banner may need a data-testid.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Only test-script false-positives (glob mismatch on **/app/** vs /app, and testing on landing page where AppShell's language-toggle doesn't exist).
